Depicted and reported content must retain its context. Do not introduce positive audio/narration under an absence claim.
Example: "A photo of Alice holding a blue cup." becomes ["A photo depicts Alice.", "Alice is holding a blue cup."]. The holding remains depicted content; do not duplicate the cup color as an extra sentence.
Return JSON with action (rewrite, keep, refuse) and sentences. For rewrite return one to twelve simpler sentences. Return an empty list for keep/refuse.
